audit.methodology: C5 frozen SciFact full-gold KD FAIL. C6 frozen 971-query official test, 24 fits and 3 seeds; Terra recomputed 6 gates and their paired query-bootstrap CIs. H6b low-gold pass does not isolate teacher information because K10 uses all train slates and G10 cycles the small gold subset; G10 is worse than A0. Multiple machines and one output-sync duplicate race pose provenance uncertainty. P5 Wave2 BGE conditional helps bridges, hurts comparison; best-single-shot comparison CI fields internally inconsistent.
audit.split_integrity: C5 previously exposed SciFact 200-query holdout is spent. C6 FiQA/NFCorpus frozen official 648/323 test used once after training. P5 early 400 pilot holdout has been exposed; P5 larger DEV2 uses 4,742 separate HotpotQA validation questions and a sealed 2,000-question sequence holdout, not evaluated.
audit.cost: C6 200k teacher scores and reported ~10.58 GPU-hours are not total end-to-end costs; FiQA seven-way scoring alone consumed 5,786 GPU-seconds and failed/duplicate work needs accounting. P5 B3R 5-label set-aware used 1,252,556 teacher input tokens vs random 971,006. P5 Wave2 ~$0.29659 metered Modal GPU/CPU inference and 25.1min local CPU.
audit.novelty: Full-gold teacher selection NO-GO under tested framing. Scarce-label KD overlaps GPL (NAACL 2022) and related pseudo-labeling. P5 has prior art SetR, DISCo, SCARLet and PRD. The newer BGE static reranking baseline is useful practice, not automatically a new method. Scientific problem reset and controlled falsification precede further training.
